sqrt_addition_chain.note: The square root behind point decompression raises to (p + 1) / 4 = 2^254 - 2^222 + 2^190 + 2^94 with an addition chain (253 squarings and 7 multiplications: x^(2^32 - 1) by repeated doubling of the exponent's length, then three shifts) instead of the bit-at-a-time square-and-multiply (256 squarings and 34 multiplications). The same power of the same element, and the check that the result squares back to the input stays.
